agent_explanation: Single e=1 body starts 0.095 below ceiling moving up at ~40.5 m/s and bounces elastically within step 1. Afterwards it is in free fall (touching_pairs empty, controller_work 0) yet vy grows by ~1.69 m/s per 0.0287 s step (-40.74 to -42.43 to -44.12), i.e. ~59 m/s2 vs declared gravity 9.81, so kinetic + total energy grows ~60 J/step from 971.9 to 1092.7 J. Small-dt rerun removes the gain, pointing to over-application of gravity across substeps (40-43 substeps/step) at large dt.
